title: Cleared Guidance and Quantum-Potential Identities for the Polar Form of a Wave Function over the Integers: a Lean 4 Formalization

description: Lean 4 (core only, v4.22.0) formalization of the denominator-free identities behind the de Broglie-Bohm guidance law and quantum-potential prefactor: Im(dpsi * conj psi) = dS |psi|^2 over Int for psi=(Rc,Rs) and its product-rule derivative (Bohm.guidance_cleared), and (-dR)(2R)=2((-dR)R) (Bohm.quantumPotential_cleared), plus three auxiliary lemmas. 5 theorems, no sorry, no user axioms; axiom audit shows only propext. The attached paper states exactly these results, with a claim-to-Lean table and verification certificate.
